selection: Minimize feasible 4400-cell lap time. Full request is the basic incumbent. Retain the basic solution as refined incumbent. Never use PPO schedules or evaluation grids for selection.
state: Keep the fastest exact prefix per rounded (speed, energy, gross recovered, gross discharged) bucket. If width is exceeded, stratify survivors by stored energy and retain the fastest in each equal-count stratum.
endpoint: Refined candidate on 8800 cells, preselected regardless of outcome. Nominal unguarded rolling lap; fixed known circuit and 55 decisions.
budget: At most 55*8*3 + 55*16*5 = 5720 block expansions, plus incumbent and validation replays. No neural training.
